finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: User input is directly processed and sent to the server without validation or sanitization.
finding.assumptions: The server interprets the received integers in a way that could lead to command execution, which is not shown in the provided code fragment.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the user-provided input is tokenized by spaces and each token is converted to an integer using atoi (lines 48-52). Since only integers are stored in the buffer and sendto (line 59) merely transmits these integers over UDP, there is no path for untrusted string data to be interpreted as an OS command within this code fragment. The client code does not construct or execute any command-line strings, thus the claim of OS command injection cannot be substantiated from the provided source. The server-side interpretation of the integers is outside the scope of this fragment and would need separate analysis.
